name: input-group

files.content: {@render children()}
{@render children()}

<script lang="ts">
	import { Button } from "#lib/components/ui/button/index.js";
	import type { InputGroupButtonProps } from "./index.js";
	const props: InputGroupButtonProps = $props();
</script>

<!-- Compact ghost button; never submits a form unless `type="submit"` is set. -->
<Button type="button" variant="ghost" size="xs" {...props} />

<script lang="ts">
	import type { InputProps } from "./index.js";
	let { value = $bindable(), class: className, ...props }: InputProps = $props();
</script>

<!-- Borderless input; the group draws the border and the focus ring. -->
<input class={["inputGroupInput", className]} data-input-group-control bind:value {...props} />

<style>
	/* Base input; fills the room between the addons */
	.inputGroupInput {
		flex: 1;
		align-self: stretch;
		box-sizing: border-box;
		outline: none;
		border: 0;
		border-radius: inherit;
		background-color: transparent;
		padding: 0 var(--input-group-padding);
		min-width: 0;
		color: inherit;
		font: inherit;
	}

	.inputGroupInput::placeholder {
		color: var(--muted-foreground);
	}

	.inputGroupInput:disabled {
		cursor: not-allowed;
	}
</style>
{@render children()}

<script lang="ts">
	import type { TextareaProps } from "./index.js";
	let { value = $bindable(), class: className, ...props }: TextareaProps = $props();
</script>

<!-- Borderless textarea that grows with its content; the group draws the border and the focus ring. -->
<textarea class={["inputGroupTextarea", className]} data-input-group-control bind:value {...props}></textarea>

<style>
	/* Base textarea */
	.inputGroupTextarea {
		flex: 1;
		box-sizing: border-box;
		outline: none;
		border: 0;
		border-radius: inherit;
		background-color: transparent;
		padding: var(--input-group-padding);
		min-width: 0;
		min-height: 4rem; /* 64px */
		field-sizing: content;
		resize: none;
		color: inherit;
		font: inherit;
	}

	.inputGroupTextarea::placeholder {
		color: var(--muted-foreground);
	}

	.inputGroupTextarea:disabled {
		cursor: not-allowed;
	}
</style>

description: A bordered field that joins an input or textarea with icons, text, and buttons on any side.
